snippet.title: 크레이지버드스튜디오
snippet.description:

사업제휴문의 : sun@crazybird.co.kr

Established in 2,000 years at Seoul KOREA. 
Crazybird Studio is an independent animation production company with strength in pre-production.
Currently, it is recognized for its best quality based on original idea and design.
We have own IP for TV series, movies, webtoons, characters, etc.
And continues to develop content for animated TV series, animated movie and new media contents.
